scale_offset_note: reflectance = DN*scale + offset per asset from STAC metadata (raster:bands); offset check: raster:bands offset 0 (pre-04.00 item); scale/offset used: {"B1": [0.0001, 0.0], "B2": [0.0001, 0.0], "B3": [0.0001, 0.0], "B4": [0.0001, 0.0], "B5": [0.0001, 0.0], "B6": [0.0001, 0.0], "B7": [0.0001, 0.0], "B8": [0.0001, 0.0], "B8A": [0.0001, 0.0], "B9": [0.0001, 0.0], "B11": [0.0001, 0.0], "B12": [0.0001, 0.0]}; no date-based -1000 DN rule; no clipping (values as computed); DN==0 -> NaN; 20/60 m bands resampled to 10 m by nearest (SCL always nearest)
water_mask_rule: 1 = SCL 6, or SCL 2/7 with NDWI(B3,B8)>0; + enclosed non-water holes <=100 px (not cloud/shadow/nodata) filled as water; then 2 px buffer next to any non-water and 5 px next to cloud/shadow removed; 0 = land/cloud 8-10/shadow 3/snow/saturated/nodata/buffer
transform_order: affine a,b,c,d,e,f (rasterio): x = a*col + b*row + c; y = d*col + e*row + f
wind_source: ERA5 via Open-Meteo archive API, 2021-03-11T11:00 UTC (L2A sensing 11:01); 12:00 = 3.05
